data.name: Andriana
data.gender_notes: Andriana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Andros, meaning man, and ana, meaning little or new. The name Andriana signifies a little warrior or new man. It is a feminine form of the name Andrew, which is derived from the same Greek roots. The name Andriana carries the meaning “Man's little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andriana usually hope their child will grow to embody man's little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with strong warrior spirit, suitable for a girl with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Andriana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's little warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andriana total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
